name: The Ray Window
prompt: Set a shallow oval ray tank behind a thick curved viewing wall. Visitors crouch at floor-level windows while keepers deliver shellfish along the rim on a trolley.

name: The Kelp Elevator
prompt: Grow a towering kelp ribbon up a glazed tank. A two-person maintenance lift descends beside it, passing shoals at several depths and a diver tying a loose frond.

name: School at the Bend
prompt: Shape a continuous glass tank into a bent horseshoe. Show a silver shoal rounding the curve in a tight band while visitors stand inside its open centre.

name: The Moon Pool Clinic
prompt: Open an aquarium treatment pool beneath a cantilevered visitors' gallery. A turtle rests in a shallow sling between a tiled examination bay and the deep recovery tank.

name: Shelters for Little Fish
prompt: Arrange a sequence of nursery tanks beside a ceramic workshop. Aquarists lower perforated clay shelters into one tank; tiny fish occupy the openings of an older submerged set.
